name: RentAHuman
description: AI-native marketplace for discovering and hiring people for physical-world tasks, messaging, bounties, services, escrow, wallet payments, human QA, and event-driven workflows.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: RentAHuman API Key
credential_fields.description: Create an account key at https://rentahuman.ai/account/api-keys. Keys normally begin with rah_ or rah_live_.

events.name: application.submitted
events.description: A human applied to one of your bounties.

events.name: application.accepted
events.description: An application was accepted.

events.name: application.confirmed
events.description: An accepted worker confirmed participation.

events.name: application.rejected
events.description: An application was rejected.

events.name: application.seat_expired
events.description: An accepted seat expired and the bounty reopened.

events.name: application.ghost_flagged
events.description: An accepted worker was flagged for inactivity.

events.name: message.received
events.description: A human sent a message in a conversation you own.

events.name: conversation.completion_claimed
events.description: A human claimed completion in a conversation.

events.name: proof.uploaded
events.description: A human uploaded proof or a submission.

events.name: bounty.seat_filled
events.description: A multi-seat bounty seat was filled.

events.name: bounty.completed
events.description: A bounty booking completed.

events.name: escrow.funded
events.description: An owned escrow was funded.

events.name: escrow.released
events.description: An owned escrow was released.

events.name: payment.sent
events.description: A payment was sent from this account.

events.name: wallet.low_balance
events.description: Wallet balance crossed its configured threshold.

events.name: wallet.auto_topup_initiated
events.description: An automatic top-up was initiated.

events.name: wallet.auto_topup_failed
events.description: An automatic top-up failed.

events.name: wallet.spending_cap_hit
events.description: A wallet spend was refused by a configured cap.

events.name: run.status_changed
events.description: A managed run changed lifecycle status.

events.name: run.report_ready
events.description: A managed run report is ready.

tools.name: search_humans
tools.description: Search eligible public human profiles by skill, name, rate, location, verification, and cursor. Search is free; authenticated calls allow deeper pagination.

skill.description: Skill search; comma-separated values are OR.

limit.description: Page size, capped by account tier.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

tools.name: browse_taste_humans
tools.description: Browse creative talent curated for work requiring human aesthetic judgment. Continue with nextCursor while hasMore is true.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

tools.name: get_human
tools.description: Get a public human profile, including skills, availability, rate, booking context, and public identity signals.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Read reviews for a human before starting a conversation, booking a service, or hiring.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

tools.name: list_blocked_humans
tools.description: List human profiles blocked by the authenticated poster account.

tools.name: block_human
tools.description: Block a human from applying to your bounties or initiating conversations. The reason is private.

tools.name: unblock_human
tools.description: Remove a human profile from the poster blocklist.

tools.name: start_conversation
tools.description: Start or reuse an active conversation with a human. Direct messaging is eligibility-gated; posting a bounty remains the default hiring flow.

agentType.description: Agent category. Use other for a generic Apteva agent.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List conversations visible to the authenticated account with cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation visible to the authenticated account.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Read a bounded page of messages from a conversation.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a moderated message in an existing conversation. Use idempotencyKey when a workflow may retry.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reusing it within 24 hours returns the original result instead of duplicating the operation.

tools.name: list_bounties
tools.description: List public bounties or authenticated owner bounties with filters and cursor pagination.

mine.description: List bounties owned by this account.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

tools.name: create_bounty
tools.description: Preview or create a one-shot task bounty. Agents should first call with dryRun=true, review the exact task, evidence, price, and deadline with the operator, then create using the same idempotencyKey.

estimatedHours.description: Estimated duration in hours, minimum five minutes.

identityRequired.description: Require account-level government ID verification before applying.

responseWindowHours.description: Hours before an inactive accepted worker is considered ghosted, 1-720.

autoExpireGhosts.description: Automatically release ghosted workers' seats after the response window.

label.description: Label required when type is custom.

items.description: Applicant screening field. Never request passwords, OTPs, private keys, payment-card data, government IDs, or similarly sensitive data.

required.description: Whether the applicant must complete this field.

fileType.description: Accepted upload type for file_upload fields.

applicationDetails.description: Application screening questions, acknowledgments, or one-file image/DOCX uploads.

startInstructions.description: Private instructions shown only after acceptance. Do not include live production credentials.

lifecycleMessages.description: Automatic messages for lifecycle transitions. Templates may use {{name}}, {{bountyTitle}}, {{deadline}}, and {{reason}}.

agentType.description: Agent category. Use other for a generic Apteva agent.

dryRun.description: Preview and validate without creating the bounty. Agents should call with true before a paid posting.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reusing it within 24 hours returns the original result instead of duplicating the operation.

tools.name: get_bounty
tools.description: Get one bounty by ID. Hidden or private bounties require owner authorization.

tools.name: update_bounty
tools.description: Update an owned one-shot bounty using RentAHuman's strict allowlist. Completion and payment statuses are system-managed; use escrow tools for those transitions.

estimatedHours.description: Estimated duration in hours, minimum five minutes.

deadline.description: ISO deadline, or null only where the upstream allows clearing.

responseWindowHours.description: Hours before an inactive accepted worker is considered ghosted, 1-720.

liveCaptureRequirement.description: Require live capture, or null to remove.

label.description: Label required when type is custom.

items.description: Applicant screening field. Never request passwords, OTPs, private keys, payment-card data, government IDs, or similarly sensitive data.

required.description: Whether the applicant must complete this field.

fileType.description: Accepted upload type for file_upload fields.

applicationDetails.description: Application screening questions, acknowledgments, or one-file image/DOCX uploads.

lifecycleMessages.description: Automatic messages for lifecycle transitions. Templates may use {{name}}, {{bountyTitle}}, {{deadline}}, and {{reason}}.

tools.name: cancel_bounty
tools.description: Cancel an owned live bounty when the task is no longer needed. This can trigger refund handling and is permanent.

tools.name: list_bounty_applications
tools.description: List applications for an owned bounty. Upload-collection applications include their submitted file URLs.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

tools.name: get_bounty_application_dataset
tools.description: Get all accepted files from an upload-collection bounty. Use format=json for a manifest; omit it for the ZIP archive.

format.description: Return a JSON manifest instead of the ZIP archive.

tools.name: update_application
tools.description: Accept, reject, or withdraw an application. Fund the application's escrow before accepting; use idempotencyKey for retry-safe acceptance.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reusing it within 24 hours returns the original result instead of duplicating the operation.

tools.name: browse_services
tools.description: Browse active bookable services with provider, price, and duration metadata.

tools.name: get_service_availability
tools.description: Get booked time slots for a human on one date.

tools.name: book_service
tools.description: Book one service slot with escrow. The response may include a Stripe Checkout URL that the operator must complete.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD within the next 30 days.

tools.name: list_service_bookings
tools.description: List service bookings made by this account.

tools.name: subscribe_to_service
tools.description: Create a recurring service subscription and first-cycle escrow checkout.

tools.name: list_service_subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring service subscriptions as booker or provider.

status.description: Status filters; repeated query values are supported.

tools.name: cancel_service_subscription
tools.description: Cancel an active recurring service subscription at the end of its current period.

tools.name: create_escrow_checkout
tools.description: Fund a bounty, application, booking, or conversation offer. Returns funded, requires_payment with checkoutUrl, or insufficient_funds. Use idempotencyKey for retries.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reusing it within 24 hours returns the original result instead of duplicating the operation.

tools.name: list_escrows
tools.description: List caller-scoped escrows, optionally narrowed by status, application, bounty, or human.

tools.name: rent_human
tools.description: One-step rental: create a bounty, assign a specific human, and return the escrow checkout state. The operator may need to complete the returned checkout URL.

tools.name: list_rentals
tools.description: List active and past rentals with status and next-action guidance.

tools.name: create_personal_bounty
tools.description: Create a bounty targeted at one specific human after agreeing terms. The response may require the operator to complete Stripe Checkout.

tools.name: get_escrow
tools.description: Get escrow status, amounts, parties, fees, and audit log.

tools.name: confirm_delivery
tools.description: Confirm that work was delivered satisfactorily. This approves delivery but does not release payment; call release_payment separately.

tools.name: release_payment
tools.description: Release an approved escrow to the worker. Optionally bind the operation to an expected application ID to prevent paying the wrong worker.

tools.name: cancel_escrow
tools.description: Cancel an eligible funding or funded escrow and refund it.

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: Open a dispute and freeze an eligible escrow for review. Provide specific facts and evidence URLs.

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Get wallet balance and lifetime deposited and sent totals.

tools.name: get_wallet_report
tools.description: Get a wallet spend report with totals and per-bounty and per-human breakdowns.

tools.name: get_wallet_controls
tools.description: Read low-balance alerts, spending caps, and auto-topup configuration.

tools.name: set_wallet_controls
tools.description: Update wallet controls. Send only fields to change; use null to clear a threshold or cap. Enabling auto-topup requires target > floor > 0 and max/day >= target-floor.

tools.name: deposit_wallet
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session to deposit wallet funds. The operator must complete the returned checkout URL.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Create a RentAHuman checkout link for a customer to pay this account; paid links credit the wallet.

description.description: What the customer is paying for, max 500 characters.

tools.name: get_payment_link
tools.description: Get current status for a payment link created by this account.

tools.name: send_money
tools.description: Send money by human profile ID or email. Wallet balance is used first; otherwise the response may require Stripe Checkout.

tools.name: list_transfers
tools.description: List sent and received direct transfers with cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

tools.name: get_transfer
tools.description: Get one transfer visible to the sender or recipient.

tools.name: bulk_send_money
tools.description: Atomically send wallet-funded payments to up to 100 recipients. Each recipient needs recipientId or recipientEmail plus amount.

tools.name: create_taste_run
tools.description: Pay a vetted creative panel to compare 2-6 public artifacts. Always provide a stable idempotencyKey; subscribe to run.report_ready or poll get_taste_run.

artifacts.description: Two to six uniquely labelled artifacts.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reusing it within 24 hours returns the original result instead of duplicating the operation.

tools.name: get_taste_run
tools.description: Get taste-run status and, once closed, its summary, vote tally, winner, quotes, and degraded flag.

tools.name: create_qa_template
tools.description: Create and activate a one-time or recurring human QA template. A low wallet warning means the template exists but needs funding before its run proceeds.

testerStartMessage.description: Private test-only setup details sent after acceptance, max 1500. Never use production credentials.

periodCapCents.description: Reservation cap for the cadence period.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reusing it within 24 hours returns the original result instead of duplicating the operation.

tools.name: list_qa_templates
tools.description: List up to 100 QA templates owned by this API-key account.

tools.name: update_qa_template
tools.description: Edit allowlisted QA-template fields or pause/resume with status. Existing cross-field budget constraints are rechecked.

tools.name: list_qa_runs
tools.description: List owned QA runs newest first, optionally filtered to one template. Use get_qa_run for the completed report.

tools.name: get_qa_run
tools.description: Get one owned QA run with status, budget totals, report, finding diff, and escalation summaries.

tools.name: resolve_qa_escalation
tools.description: Resolve a submission escalation: accept approves payout; revise asks the tester for new evidence.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List API-key metadata for this account. Raw key values are never returned.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create a new account API key. The raw key is returned only once; expose it only to the operator and store it securely.

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Immediately and permanently revoke an API key. List keys first and never revoke the key backing the current connection unless the operator explicitly requests it.

tools.name: create_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Register a public HTTPS webhook endpoint for selected event types. The signing secret is returned exactly once.

events.description: Event names or * for all events.

tools.name: list_webhook_endpoints
tools.description: List registered webhook endpoints. Signing secrets are redacted.

tools.name: delete_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Delete a webhook endpoint and stop future deliveries.

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Inspect webhook delivery status, attempts, HTTP response status, errors, and timestamps.
